title: Fixed database connection timeout
content: The connection pool was exhausted because we weren't releasing connections in the finally block. Fixed by wrapping DB calls in try/finally.

title: Use JSON flat-file over SQLite for storage
content: SQLite requires native module compilation (better-sqlite3) which breaks on Electron ABI changes. JSON with atomic writes is sufficient for our scale and avoids compilation issues.

title: esbuild handles ESM packages transparently
content: glob v11 is ESM-only but esbuild bundles it into CJS output without any configuration. moduleResolution: bundler in tsconfig prevents TypeScript errors on ESM imports.
